## Objectives
* Plot treecluster genotypes on ML trees as tipcolors

* tanglegrams of trees linked by genotype

# Setup
## libs
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ape)
library(ggtree)
library(gtools)
library(RColorBrewer)
```

## ins/outs
```{r}
#threshold of choice 
thresh<-"0.04"

#TREES
tree.fold<-"../../../02_iqtree/iq_gtrfr10_rooted/"
trees.in<-list.files(tree.fold,pattern = ".treefile",full.names = T) %>%  mixedsort()

# tree.fold<-"../../../01_fasttree/ft_rooted_outliers/2026-01-14_rem-outliers/rem_out/"
# trees.in<-list.files(tree.fold,pattern = ".tre",full.names = T) %>%
#   mixedsort()

l.tr<-length(trees.in)

## SequenceNames and new_geno are in the tc dfs
tc.geno.fold<-list.files("../03_tc_genotypes/", pattern = thresh,include.dirs=TRUE,full.names = T)
tc.geno.in<-list.files(tc.geno.fold, pattern = "newgeno.csv", full.names = T) %>% mixedsort()

segments.ms<-c("PB2","PB1","PA","HA","NP","NA","M","NS")%>% mixedsort()

# outputs
today<-Sys.Date()
f.out.tree<-paste0(today,"_",thresh, "_tc_geno_trees_out/")
if(!dir.exists(f.out.tree)){dir.create(f.out.tree)}
```

```{r}
#plotting theme
plot.theme<-theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
                  panel.background = element_rect("grey95"), 
                  axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
                  text=element_text(size=10,face="bold"),
                  legend.text=element_text(size=8),
                  axis.text.x=element_text(angle = 45,hjust=1,vjust=1))

```

## Read in the iqtrees, genotypes, plot em
```{r}
tc.geno<-trees<-replicate(n=l.tr, vector())
geno.cols<-replicate(vector,n=l.tr)

for (i in 1:l.tr){
  trees[[i]]<-ape::read.tree(trees.in[i])
  tc.geno[[i]]<-read.csv(tc.geno.in[i])
  print(all(trees[[i]]$tip.label %in% tc.geno[[i]]$SequenceName))
  
  #trees with tips colored by genotype
  segment<-segments.ms[i]
  if(is.na(segment)){segment<-"NA_seg"}
  tc.geno[[i]]<-tc.geno[[i]] %>% select(SequenceName, new_geno)

  NN<-Ntip(trees[[i]])

  #use the same colors in plots below
  n.genotype<-length(table(tc.geno[[i]]$new_geno)) #excl NA
  geno.cols[[i]]<-colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(name="Paired",n=12))(n.genotype)
  names(geno.cols[[i]])<- sample(unique(tc.geno[[i]]$new_geno)) #shuffle it for contrast
  
  #basic tree
  t<-ggtree(trees[[i]])+
    geom_tree()+
    geom_treescale(x=0, y=ceiling(NN*0.95),
                   fontsize=3, linesize=0.5, offset=200)

  # Add the genotypes
  # all( tc.geno[[i]]$SequenceName %in% trees[[i]]$tip.label)
  t <- t %<+% tc.geno[[i]]
  t2 <- t + geom_tippoint(aes(color = new_geno),size=0.7,alpha=0.7) +
    # geom_tiplab(aes(color=new_geno, label=new_geno),size=1.5,offset=0.01)+
      theme(legend.position = "right",
            legend.title=element_text(face="bold")) +
    ggtitle(segment)+
    scale_color_manual(values=geno.cols[[i]], na.value="grey70")+
    guides(color=guide_legend(override.aes = list(size=1)))+
    theme(legend.position = "none")
  t2; ggsave(paste0(f.out.tree, segment,"_",thresh,"_tree_new_geno_TipColor.tiff"),
         width=5,height=9,units="in")
}
```
